en: Hello {tester}, test cycle {cycle_id} ({cycle}, round {round}) on {project} starts on {date}. Please prepare {planned} cases and the test data.
mt: Merhaba {tester}, test döngüsü {cycle_id} ({cycle}, yuvarlak {round}) {project} {date} başlıyor.

en: Hello, deliverable {name} on {project} has waited {waiting} days for the client. The decision was due by {decide_by}. Please call {contact}.
mt: Merhaba, teslimat {name} {project} {waiting} gün bekledi.

en: Hello {support_owner}, I am sending the access and contacts list for {service} on {project}. Please check your accounts before {start}. Handover items done: {handover_done}.
mt: Merhaba {support_owner}, {service} için erişim ve iletişim listesini gönderiyorum {project}. Lütfen hesaplarınızı {start}'dan önce kontrol edin.

en: The acceptor, {col:deliverables.acceptor}, confirms that the deliverable meets the agreed acceptance criteria. Any open comments are listed on the acceptance sheet and are planned for a later release.
mt: Kabul eden, teslimatın kabul kriterlerini karşıladığını onaylar.

en: The payment tied to this acceptance is {col:deliverables.payment_due}. The acceptance check shows: {col:deliverables.state}.
mt: Bu kabulle bağlı ödeme {col:deliverables.payment_due}.

en: Project: {col:defects.project}. Project manager: {col:defects.manager}.
mt: Proje yöneticisi:

en: The defect is assigned to {col:defects.assignee}. The fix target for this severity is {col:defects.target} days. The defect is {col:defects.age} days old if it is still open, and it took {col:defects.days_to_close} days to close if it is closed.
mt: Bu ciddiyet için düzeltme hedefi {col:defects.target} gündür. Eğer hâlâ açıksa, {col:defects.age} gündür ve kapalı ise kapatması {col:defects.days_to_close} gün sürmüştür.

en: Project: {col:cycles.project}. Project manager: {col:cycles.manager}. Cycle {col:cycles.cycle_id}: {col:cycles.cycle}, round {col:cycles.round}, on {col:cycles.date}. Tester: {col:cycles.tester}.
mt: Proje: {col:cycles.project}. Proje yöneticisi: {col:cycles.manager}. Döngü {col:cycles.cycle_id}: {col:cycles.cycle}, yuvarlak {col:cycles.round}, {col:cycles.date}.

en: The pass rate needed to leave the cycle is {set:pass_exit}. The check shows: {col:cycles.state}.
mt: Döngüden çıkmak için gereken geçiş oranı {set:pass_exit}.

en: To: Finance partner, telephone {col:payments.fin_phone}. Project: {col:payments.project}. Milestone {col:payments.pay_id}: {col:payments.milestone}.
mt: Finans ortağı için, telefon.

en: The milestone was accepted on {col:payments.accepted_on}. Please invoice {col:payments.amount}, which is {col:payments.share} of the contract price, to {col:payments.contact}, telephone {col:payments.phone}.
mt: Lütfen sözleşme fiyatının {col:payments.share} olan faturayı {col:payments.contact}, telefon {col:payments.phone} adresine gönderin.

en: Support is taken over by {col:transition.support_owner}, telephone {col:transition.support_phone}, from {col:transition.start}. The handover status is {col:transition.status}.
mt: Destek {col:transition.support_owner}, telefon {col:transition.support_phone}, {col:transition.start} tarafından devralınır.

en: The measure is: {col:benefits.measure}. The baseline is {col:benefits.baseline} and the final target is {col:benefits.target}. The benefit is live from {col:benefits.since}.
mt: Ölçüm şudur: {col:benefits.measure}. Baza çizgisi {col:benefits.baseline} ve nihai hedef {col:benefits.target}.

en: The benefit check shows: {col:benefits.state}. The next review is on {col:benefits.review}. The review check shows: {col:benefits.review_state}.
mt: Fayda kontrolü gösterir: {col:benefits.state}.

en: {col:projects.accepted} of {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables are accepted. The test pass rate is {col:projects.pass_rate}. There are {col:projects.defects_open} open defects, of which {col:projects.crit_open} are critical.
mt: {col:projects.accepted} teslimatların kabul edilir. Test geçiş oranı {col:projects.pass_rate}. {col:projects.defects_open} açık kusurlar vardır, bunlardan {col:projects.crit_open} kritiktir.

en: The budget now is {col:projects.budget_now} and {col:projects.spent} was spent. The rework share of effort is {col:projects.rework_share}.
mt: Bütçe şimdi {col:projects.budget_now} ve {col:projects.spent} harcanmıştır.

en: Ratings from 1 to 5: schedule {col:ppr.schedule}, cost {col:ppr.cost}, scope {col:ppr.scope} and client {col:ppr.client}. The overall rating is {col:ppr.overall}.
mt: 1 ile 5 arasındaki derecelendirmeler: zamanlama {col:ppr.schedule}, maliyet {col:ppr.cost}, kapsam {col:ppr.scope} ve müşteri {col:ppr.client}.

en: {col:warranty.claims} claim(s) were made so far. The warranty check shows: {col:warranty.state}.
mt: {col:warranty.claims} iddialar şimdiye kadar yapıldı.

en: We confirm that {col:projects.accepted} of {col:projects.deliverables} deliverables of the project are accepted. The project ended on {col:projects.actual_end}.
mt: Projenin teslimatlarının kabul edildiğini onaylıyoruz. Projenin sonu {col:projects.actual_end} oldu.
